question: Which cancer kills the most people worldwide each year: breast, prostate, bowel or lung?
answer: Lung, about 1.8 million deaths in 2022, then bowel at about 900,000, by the WHO cancer agency's count. Bowel cancer grows for years out of small polyps, so a test can catch it early, or prevent it when a polyp is removed. Many health services post home stool kits.
move: Rank diseases by their death toll, then ask which one a test can catch.
reference: Bray, F. et al. (2024) Global cancer statistics 2022: GLOBOCAN estimates of incidence and mortality worldwide for 36 cancers in 185 countries, CA: A Cancer Journal for Clinicians 74(3): 229-263
ask: Have I been sent a bowel screening kit, and did I send it back?

items.label: Breast
items.note: The commonest cancer in women, yet it kills fewer people than bowel cancer.

items.label: Prostate
items.note: Common in older men, many of whom die with it rather than of it.

items.label: Lung
items.note: More than breast and bowel together, and mostly caused by smoking.

items.label: Bowel
items.note: Second, and the one a home stool test can catch early.
